parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a man inquiring about summer holiday job vacancies at a resort.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

Hello. I saw an advert for holiday staff on the notice board, and I'm very interested. Can you tell me something about the resort?

Let me see. Yes, those jobs are at the Sandy Shores Resort. You may have heard of it as it's quite well known in the area.

I'm not sure. Where exactly is it?

It's on Jameson Island.

I haven't heard of that one. Uh, how do you spell it?

J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N. It was named after a famous explorer.

Oh, sounds interesting.

Yes, it's a beautiful place, and as it's a large resort, they have vacancies in a few different areas.

When would they want someone to start?

It looks like the applications close by the twelfth of May, and they would need you to begin from the eleventh of July.

Oh, that's perfect. My exams finish on the fifth of July. Can you tell me something about the jobs?

Well, first of all, there is a vacancy in the Calypso Bistro. That's for a waiter. The work is quite easy, taking orders and serving meals. You don't need any experience as they will train you.

That's good.

They've also got a few vacancies in what is called the guest liaison department. They are involved with the entertainment in the resort, especially the daily music shows and parades. They definitely need people who can sing. What's your voice like?

Ugh. It's shocking. Uh, but I can play piano. Would that be useful?

I don't think so. They already have a band.

Okay. So what else is there?

Among the most popular things for guests are the games and water sports activities, which take place on the beach that belongs to the resort. They are always looking for fit young people to help out with things like volleyball, surfing, and cricket, but they definitely need people who have worked with children for that vacancy.

Well, I coach junior basketball.

Sounds great. Finally, there are vacancies in the reception area. You'd work as part of the concierge department, carrying bags to and from rooms. A requirement for this role is that you can drive. That might seem strange, but some of the villas are quite far away from the resort hub, so they have little golf buggies to take the bags over to them.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten on page two.

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

I expect you'd like to know a bit more about the general benefits for staff.

Yes, please. Do they provide free accommodation for staff?

It looks like they only provide it to permanent employees, but staff don't have to pay for transport to and from the island, so you'd have to stay in Port Thomas, but there are plenty of cheap places there.

What about meals?

Yes, they're provided when you're on duty, so you would save money on groceries. If you are interested, we can set up an interview for you. I know the resort personnel manager wants interviews on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday here at the college. Which day would suit you?

Can we do it on Thursday as I work on Wednesdays?

Fine. Is two o'clock okay?

Perfect.

Okay. I've booked you in for then.

Is there anything I need to take to the interview?

Let me see.

Yes, you need to bring a CV giving details of your work experience and qualifications, and because they are planning on interviewing a lot of people, they've asked everyone to provide a photo as well so they can remember who is who. Do you have any questions?

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到了地点在 Jameson Island，并给出了具体拼写 J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N。
你可能因为拼写速度较快而漏听字母，注意听清每一个字母的拼读即可。
It's on Jameson Island. I haven't heard of that one. Uh, how do you spell it? J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N.
男生提问什么时候开始，女生回答从7月11日开始（begin from the eleventh of July）。
你可能会听到“twelfth of May”（5月12日），但那是申请截止日期（applications close），不是工作开始的时间。
When would they want someone to start? It looks like the applications close by the twelfth of May, and they would need you to begin from the eleventh of July.
录音直接提到 Calypso Bistro 的空缺职位是服务员（waiter）。
这道题非常直接，听到地点 Calypso Bistro 后直接抓取紧接着的职业名词即可。
Well, first of all, there is a vacancy in the Calypso Bistro. That's for a waiter.
录音提到在 guest liaison 部门，明确需要会唱歌的人（people who can sing）。
你可能会因为听到男生后面说“can play piano”（弹钢琴）而填错，但那是男生的提问，且被女生明确否定了。

They've also got a few vacancies in what is called the guest liaison department. They are involved with the entertainment in the resort, especially the daily music shows and parades. They definitely need people who can sing.
录音中明确提到这个职位需要有与儿童（children）一起工作的经验。
你可能会被前面的 volleyball, surfing, cricket 等运动名称干扰，但这些是工作内容，题目问的是需要和“谁”相处的经验。

Among the most popular things for guests are the games and water sports activities, which take place on the beach that belongs to the resort. They are always looking for fit young people to help out with things like volleyball, surfing, and cricket. But they definitely need people who have worked with children for that vacancy.
录音中明确指出前台行李员这个职位的要求（requirement）是你得会开车（drive）。
如果没抓到答案词，你可能会被后面解释为什么要开车的“golf buggies”（高尔夫球车）干扰，但卷面需要的是一个动词技能。
Finally, there are vacancies in the reception area. You'd work as part of the concierge department, carrying bags to and from rooms. A requirement for this role is that you can drive.
录音中说员工不需要为往返岛屿的交通（transport）付费，完美对应题目的“free（免费）”。
你可能会听到男生提问的“accommodation”（住宿），但录音接着澄清了免费住宿仅限正式员工，所以不能填它。
Do they provide free accommodation for staff? It looks like they only provide it to permanent employees. But staff don't have to pay for transport to and from the island.
男生提问餐食（meals）如何，女生给予肯定回答，说值班时会提供（provided）。
你可能会被后面的 groceries（食品杂货）干扰，但那是说提供餐食所以能“省下买杂货的钱”，实际提供的东西是 meals。
What about meals? Yes, they're provided when you're on duty, so you would save money on groceries.
录音中给出了三个可选日子，男生最终提出了星期四（Thursday），并得到了女生的确认（Fine）。
你可能会听到 Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 三个词，如果没有听完男生最终敲定的日子就下笔，很容易把前面的 Wednesday 当成答案。

I know the resort personnel manager wants interviews on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday here at the college. Which day would suit you? Can we do it on Thursday, as I work on Wednesdays? Fine. Is two o'clock okay?
录音明确说到除了带简历（CV），还需要提供一张照片（photo）。
你可能会听到 work experience（工作经验）或 qualifications（资质），但这些是简历包含的内容，题目问的是除了 CV 还需要带什么附加的独立物品。

Is there anything I need to take to the interview? Let me see. Yes, you need to bring a CV giving details of your work experience and qualifications. And because they are planning on interviewing a lot of people, they've asked everyone to provide a photo as well, so they can remember who is who.
